title: Checks for break statements outside of loops.
summary: The use of a break statement outside of a for or while loop will raise a SyntaxError. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.36.

title: Checks for continue statements outside of loops.
summary: The use of a continue statement outside of a for or while loop will raise a SyntaxError. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.36.

title: Checks for yield, yield from, and await usages outside of functions.
summary: The use of yield, yield from, or await outside of a function will raise a SyntaxError. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.22.

title: Checks for return statements outside of functions.
summary: The use of a return statement outside of a function will raise a SyntaxError. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.18.

title: Checks for except blocks that handle all exceptions, but are not the last except block in a try statement.
summary: When an exception is raised within a try block, the except blocks are evaluated in order, and the first matching block is executed. If an except block handles all exceptions, but isn't the last block, Python will raise a SyntaxError, as the following blocks would never be executed. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.28.
message_templates: An `except` block as not the last exception handler

title: Checks for forward annotations that include invalid syntax.
summary: In Python, type annotations can be quoted as strings literals to enable references to types that have not yet been defined, known as "forward references". Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.39.
